mapper.sql: exists ( select 1 from model_routes r join providers p on p.id = r.provider_id and p.deleted = 0 and p.status = 'ACTIVE' join provider_tokens t on t.provider_id = p.id and t.deleted = 0 and t.status = 'ACTIVE' where r.model_id = m.id and r.status = 'ACTIVE' and r.upstream_model is not null and r.upstream_model <> '' )

select g.id, g.group_code as groupCode, g.group_name as groupName, g.package_type as packageType, g.sale_price as salePrice, g.package_days as packageDays, g.daily_quota as dailyQuota, g.weekly_quota as weeklyQuota, g.monthly_quota as monthlyQuota, g.remark, ( select count(*) from model_group_models mgm join models m on m.id = mgm.model_id where mgm.group_id = g.id and m.deleted = 0 and m.status = 'ACTIVE' and ) as modelCount from model_groups g

select p.id, p.group_id as groupId, g.group_code as groupCode, g.group_name as groupName, g.package_type as packageType, p.expires_at as expiresAt, p.status, g.package_days as packageDays, g.daily_quota as dailyQuota, g.weekly_quota as weeklyQuota, g.monthly_quota as monthlyQuota from user_model_packages p join model_groups g on g.id = p.group_id
mapper.update: update users set package_restriction_enabled = case when upper(role_code) = 'ADMIN' then 0 else 1 end where deleted = 0
mapper.select: where g.status = 'ACTIVE' order by field(g.group_code, 'claude', 'codex', 'gpt'), g.id asc
where p.user_id = #{userId} and p.status <> 'DELETED' order by p.expires_at desc, p.id desc limit 1

select coalesce(sum(case when request_date = #{today} then user_amount else 0 end), 0) as dailyUsed, coalesce(sum(case when request_date between #{weekStart} and #{today} then user_amount else 0 end), 0) as weeklyUsed, coalesce(sum(case when request_date between #{monthStart} and #{today} then user_amount else 0 end), 0) as monthlyUsed, coalesce(sum(user_amount), 0) as totalUsed from request_logs where user_package_id = #{packageId}

select count(*) from model_group_models mgm join models m on m.id = mgm.model_id where mgm.group_id = #{groupId} and mgm.model_id = #{modelId} and m.deleted = 0 and m.status = 'ACTIVE' and exists ( select 1 from model_routes r join providers p on p.id = r.provider_id and p.deleted = 0 and p.status = 'ACTIVE' join provider_tokens t on t.provider_id = p.id and t.deleted = 0 and t.status = 'ACTIVE' where r.model_id = m.id and r.status = 'ACTIVE' and r.upstream_model is not null and r.upstream_model <> '' )

join model_group_models mgm on mgm.group_id = g.id where p.user_id = #{userId} and p.status = 'ACTIVE' and p.expires_at > now() and mgm.model_id = #{modelId} order by p.expires_at desc, p.id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into model_group_models ( group_id, model_id, billing_type, prompt_price, cached_prompt_price, completion_price, request_price, multiplier ) select #{groupId}, m.id, coalesce(#{billingType}, m.billing_type), coalesce(#{promptPrice}, m.prompt_price), coalesce(#{cachedPromptPrice}, m.cached_prompt_price), coalesce(#{completionPrice}, m.completion_price), coalesce(#{requestPrice}, m.request_price), coalesce(#{multiplier}, m.multiplier) from models m where m.id = #{modelId}
mapper.update: update model_group_models set billing_type = #{billingType}, prompt_price = #{promptPrice}, cached_prompt_price = #{cachedPromptPrice}, completion_price = #{completionPrice}, request_price = #{requestPrice}, multiplier = #{multiplier} where model_id = #{modelId} and group_id = #{groupId}
update model_group_models set billing_type = null, prompt_price = null, cached_prompt_price = null, completion_price = null, request_price = null, multiplier = null where model_id = #{modelId}

update model_group_models mgm join models m on m.id = mgm.model_id set mgm.billing_type = coalesce(mgm.billing_type, m.billing_type), mgm.prompt_price = coalesce(mgm.prompt_price, m.prompt_price), mgm.cached_prompt_price = coalesce(mgm.cached_prompt_price, m.cached_prompt_price), mgm.completion_price = coalesce(mgm.completion_price, m.completion_price), mgm.request_price = coalesce(mgm.request_price, m.request_price), mgm.multiplier = coalesce(mgm.multiplier, m.multiplier) where mgm.billing_type is null or mgm.prompt_price is null or mgm.cached_prompt_price is null or mgm.completion_price is null or mgm.request_price is null or mgm.multiplier is null
mapper.select: select p.id, p.user_id as userId, u.username, p.group_id as groupId, g.group_code as groupCode, g.group_name as groupName, g.package_type as packageType, ( select count(*) from model_group_models mgm join models m on m.id = mgm.model_id where mgm.group_id = g.id and m.deleted = 0 and m.status = 'ACTIVE' and ) as modelCount, p.purchase_price as purchasePrice, p.start_at as startAt, p.expires_at as expiresAt, p.status, p.created_at as createdAt, g.package_days as packageDays, g.daily_quota as dailyQuota, g.weekly_quota as weeklyQuota, g.monthly_quota as monthlyQuota from user_model_packages p join users u on u.id = p.user_id and u.deleted = 0 join model_groups g on g.id = p.group_id where p.status <> 'DELETED' order by p.id desc limit #{limit}

select p.id, p.user_id as userId, u.username, p.group_id as groupId, g.group_code as groupCode, g.group_name as groupName, g.package_type as packageType, ( select count(*) from model_group_models mgm join models m on m.id = mgm.model_id where mgm.group_id = g.id and m.deleted = 0 and m.status = 'ACTIVE' and ) as modelCount, p.purchase_price as purchasePrice, p.start_at as startAt, p.expires_at as expiresAt, p.status, p.created_at as createdAt, g.package_days as packageDays, g.daily_quota as dailyQuota, g.weekly_quota as weeklyQuota, g.monthly_quota as monthlyQuota from user_model_packages p join users u on u.id = p.user_id and u.deleted = 0 join model_groups g on g.id = p.group_id where p.user_id = #{userId} and p.status <> 'DELETED' order by p.id desc limit #{limit}

select t.id, t.user_id as userId, u.username, t.wallet_id as walletId, t.order_no as orderNo, t.transaction_type as transactionType, t.direction, t.amount, t.balance_before as balanceBefore, t.balance_after as balanceAfter, t.status, t.description_text as descriptionText, t.transaction_date as transactionDate, t.created_at as createdAt from transactions t join users u on u.id = t.user_id and u.deleted = 0 order by t.id desc limit #{limit}

select t.id, t.user_id as userId, u.username, t.wallet_id as walletId, t.order_no as orderNo, t.transaction_type as transactionType, t.direction, t.amount, t.balance_before as balanceBefore, t.balance_after as balanceAfter, t.status, t.description_text as descriptionText, t.transaction_date as transactionDate, t.created_at as createdAt from transactions t join users u on u.id = t.user_id and u.deleted = 0 where t.user_id = #{userId} order by t.id desc limit #{limit}
